answer: Sybil resistance by serialized work chains: every new identity must extend an existing identity's hash chain, solving a puzzle whose seed depends on the parent's transcript, so a clone farm pays one full puzzle per clone in strict sequence, not in parallel. A farmer burns a plume of compute plus wall-clock time per fake identity, exceeding the epoch reward, while an honest agent pays once. The garden of verified identities stays small and its gate grows like a glacier: slow, yet never retreating.
